Rural/remote context can affect access to child and specialist mental-health services; it is not a causal identity label.
Developmental paedophilic etiology remains unknown/multifactorial; rare acquired cases require neurological differential diagnosis, so bereavement alone is not an admitted cause.
Paedophilic preference/disorder and child sexual offending are separate variables and must never be inferred from one another without evidence.

Child trauma can affect mental health, while TGD/gender-diverse identity is not itself pathology and is not admitted as an outcome caused by trauma; family acceptance/rejection may affect mental health and disclosure.
